name: Martian tripod
notes: Origin on the ground at the tripod centre, front +Z, up +Y, 30 m tall. Authored pose is the full stand; joint value rise 0 sinks the hood 22 m and folds the legs flat. Joints stride -1...1, rise 0...1, cowl -1...1 (yaw 50 deg), aim 0...1 (pitch down 35 deg), charge 0...1 are empty drivers; child parts mimic them. Follower lensGlow switches option at charge 0.05. Legs at azimuth +60, -60 and 180 degrees.
parts: flattened lofted hood, 64 stations by 64 radial points, gunmetal upper shell and oiled lower shell
three legs of three 48-sided tube segments with ball knees and foot pads
articulated cowl with glass heat-ray lens, emissive green core and eight-leaf iris
six tapered whip tentacles under the hood, 64 stations each
style: Weathered gunmetal war machine with clearcoat, oil-dark lower shell, steel ball joints and a green glowing heat-ray lens, original shapes only.
summary: 30 m Martian tripod: lofted gunmetal hood, three jointed legs with ball knees, articulated heat-ray cowl with glass lens and iris, six whip tentacles.
